title: Request Channel and Proceeds Delivery Points in Operating Lines of Credit Overadvance Pricing
content:
How an overadvancing advance on the Operating Lines of Credit was requested, and where its proceeds went, moves the fee percentage up or down by a set number of points.

## Rule

- **0.25 points are added** to the fee percentage when the advance was requested through online banking or the mobile app.
- **0.25 points are taken off** the fee percentage when the advance was requested through any other channel and its proceeds were paid directly to an input supplier.
- **Nothing is added or taken off** when the advance was requested through any other channel with any other delivery of proceeds.

The points change the percentage itself: the fee percentage with these points added or taken off is the percentage the overadvance portion is multiplied by. The channel and the delivery of proceeds are those shown for the advance in the line's transaction history.

## Combinations

| Channel of the advance | Proceeds delivered | Points |
|---|---|---|
| Online banking | Any | Plus 0.25 |
| Mobile app | Any, including directly to an input supplier | Plus 0.25 |
| Phone | Directly to an input supplier | Minus 0.25 |
| Branch | Directly to an input supplier | Minus 0.25 |
| Phone or branch | Checking account, check or wire | None |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

With a fee percentage of 1.00% before these points, an advance requested by phone and paid directly to a fertilizer supplier is priced at 0.75%; the same advance requested through online banking is priced at 1.25%.
